description: Cartographie de la zone intertidale de la baie de l'Aiguillon (Etat 2002). Partie 3/4 : digues de ceinture (ouvrage de défense contre la mer) de la réserve de la baie de l'Aiguillon sous forme de polygones is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This mapping, in the form of a polygon, represents the location in 2001 and 2002 of the earthen dykes of the Aiguillon Bay Reserve and was done at the same time as the updating of the mapping of plant groups. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Mapping of the intertidal zone of Aiguillon Bay (State 2002). Part 3/4: Belt dikes (defence structure against the sea) o" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Gestion, habitat, réserve naturelle, pré salé, estran, intertidal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
